constraints.statement: FEAT-273 G7 policy: the infographic-HTML path is deprecated in favour of OutputMode.A2UI + Infographic component + SSR-HTML renderer; the infographic-JSON path is explicitly kept. Yet InfographicToolkit.__init__ constructs the deprecated renderer unconditionally, so every toolkit instance trips the warning.
constraints.implication: A migration must decide whether to honour G7 (retire the HTML lane) or amend it (HTML artifact stays as a dual-emit sibling).

constraints.statement: The adapter is deliberately lossy: 7 chart types collapse, and presentation-only fields (layout, color_by_sign, per-series colors, table style, bullet columns) are dropped.
constraints.implication: financial_variance and other presentation-tuned templates will not look identical after migration unless the Infographic component / renderers grow presentation props.

constraints.statement: The bundled ai-parrot-server UI has no A2UI renderer; only output_mode==infographic opens the canvas. The A2UI Svelte renderer is specified for the external navigator-frontend-next project.
constraints.implication: Flipping emit_a2ui (or retiring INFOGRAPHIC) makes infographics disappear from the bundled UI until it can render a2ui_envelope or is given the HTML artifact URL alongside.

constraints.statement: Themes are already lane-neutral: DesignSystem resolves ThemeConfig for both the legacy renderer and the A2UI HTML renderers (FEAT-493).
constraints.implication: Themes need no migration; the A2UI Infographic component only needs to carry the theme name hint it already has.

constraints.statement: Templates are prompt-generation artefacts (block order + constraints for the LLM), not rendering artefacts.
constraints.implication: They can survive as-is upstream of the adapter, or be re-expressed as deterministic A2UI recipes/LayoutSpecs — an architectural fork, not a mechanical port.

constraints.statement: Streaming is force-disabled for OutputMode.INFOGRAPHIC because the signed URL must arrive atomically; OutputMode.A2UI has no such gate in AgentTalk.
constraints.implication: Moving infographics to A2UI changes the streaming behaviour of those turns.

constraints.statement: A second, genuinely Jinja/HTML lane exists: InfographicToolkit.render_template + InfographicTalk /render (FEAT-327) fills trusted developer-supplied HTML+Jinja templates.
constraints.implication: The user's 'jinja templates' intuition maps to THIS lane, which has no A2UI counterpart and probably should stay HTML.

constraints.statement: No production caller sets emit_a2ui=True (only the example walkthrough); InfographicAuthoringMixin, InfographicTalk, ResultAgent use the default; AgentStudio forwards **params.
constraints.implication: Today's AgentTalk/InfoAgent/FlexDashboard infographic_render turns are HTML-lane turns.

unknowns.question: Target end state: retire OutputMode.INFOGRAPHIC in favour of OutputMode.A2UI + Infographic component (single lane, honours FEAT-273 G7), or keep dual-emit (A2UI envelope + HTML artifact URL) permanently?
plausible_answers: a) single A2UI lane; HTML becomes a renderer output (ssr-html/interactive-html) of the same envelope
b) dual-emit forever: flip emit_a2ui default to True, keep INFOGRAPHIC envelope for legacy consumers
c) keep HTML lane as-is; only FlexDashboard-style recipe agents use A2UI
unknowns.user_answer: Dual-emit permanently — flip emit_a2ui default to True; keep INFOGRAPHIC HTML envelope alongside a2ui_envelope

unknowns.question: Which frontend is the consumer of record for AgentTalk infographics: the bundled ai-parrot-server UI (no A2UI renderer today) or navigator-frontend-next (A2UI renderer planned)?
plausible_answers: a) navigator-frontend-next only — bundled UI keeps iframe HTML via html_url until it gets a renderer
b) both — the bundled UI must gain a minimal A2UI Infographic renderer as part of this feature
c) bundled UI is a demo; break it if needed
unknowns.user_answer: Both — navigator-frontend-next primary; bundled ai-parrot-server UI gains a minimal A2UI Infographic renderer in this feature

unknowns.question: Fate of InfographicTemplate block-order templates and the 19 block models: keep them upstream (LLM → InfographicResponse → adapter) or re-express templates as deterministic A2UI recipes/LayoutSpecs and let the LLM author Infographic sections directly?
plausible_answers: a) keep InfographicResponse as the LLM contract; adapter is the bridge (accept lossy chart/presentation degradation)
b) migrate templates to recipes/LayoutSpecs; deprecate InfographicResponse blocks
c) extend the Infographic component/renderers with the missing presentation props first, then decide
unknowns.user_answer: Extend A2UI presentation props first — grow Infographic component/renderers with dropped chart types and presentation fields before choosing templates fate; InfographicResponse stays the LLM contract
